## Problem and resulting behavior

Linked GitHub issue:

Describe the concrete trigger and changed behavior. Keep task status and follow-ups on the issue.

## Verification

State exact head, commands, results, evidence links and adverse cases. Distinguish offline, native, live and model/empirical checks; skipped checks are not passes.

## Review

Link the issue handoff and request a scoped review before merge. Explain remaining limits and contract changes. Close the issue only after its acceptance criteria are met; create linked child issues for remaining scope.
